journal: International Journal of Coal Science & Technology
title: Synthesis of activated carbon from Zhundong coal and its hydrogen storage application
material_description: ZD-HK-AC | Zhundong coal (60-80 mesh) pretreated in 5 M HCl, mixed with KOH powder and carbonized/activated in a tube furnace under N2/CO2 flow, then washed in 2 M HCl. Same sample as ZD-HK3-AC (Table 5, abstract, Fig. 4b, Fig. 8 text; alkali-carbon ratio 3): identical Table 4 and Table 5 rows (S_lang 2311, S_BET 1980, S_mic 1069, V_total 1.02, V_meso 0.52, V_mic 0.50, dp 1.96, 0.91 wt%) and the same isotherm in Fig. 4a and 4b
purification_method: 5 M HCl pretreatment of the coal (50 °C, 24 h, magnetic stirring), water wash, dried 100 °C 24 h; after activation 2 M HCl post-treatment (60 °C, 12 h), water wash to neutral, dried 100 °C 24 h
activation_method: KOH powder mixed with the HCl-pretreated coal (alkali-carbon ratio 3 per the ZD-HK3-AC label), carbonized in a horizontal tube furnace under 200 mL/min N2 + 100 mL/min CO2 with a temperature ramp program (temperature not stated)
source_location: main p5 Table 4 (ZD-HK-AC, H2 uptake) and Table 5 (ZD-HK3-AC, H2 uptake); 80 bar printed in abstract (p1) and Table 7 (p10, 303 K 80 bar 0.91, This work); main p6 Fig. 4a series ZD-HK-AC and Fig. 4b series ZD-HK3-AC, highest-pressure marker
notes: digitized: 78.450 bar, 0.9070 wt%, archive: HYC-0064_Fig4a_ZD-HK-AC.json. Same isotherm replotted in Fig. 4b as ZD-HK3-AC, highest marker digitized: 79.381 bar, 0.9040 wt%, archive: HYC-0064_Fig4b_ZD-HK3-AC.json (Fig. 4a and 4b curves agree within 0.003 wt% at every marker; the last two markers sit about 1 bar apart in pressure between the two panels). Value 0.91 wt% also printed in abstract ('0.91 wt% under the condition of 80bar at room temperature'), conclusions, Table 7 and Fig. 10 ('This work'). The text of Section 3.2 prints a conflicting 1.26 wt% at 80 bar for this sample (separate row). Repeated isotherms of this sample shown in Fig. 8 (5 adsorption-desorption cycles), so replicates_reported = true; Fig. 8 reaches only about 0.72-0.74 wt% near 81-82 bar. T = 303 K taken from Table 7 (p10: 'ZD Coal | 303 K 80 bar | 0.91 | 1980 | This work'); the text says all H2 tests were at room temperature and prints no other number. Pressure axis of Fig. 4/8 is labelled absolute. Basis not named by the paper; volumetric (H-Sorb 2600T, procedure with sample-tube volume calibration) so basis_inferred = excess by instrumental default. Instrument model H-Sorb 2600T named without manufacturer. Free-volume calibration mentioned ('calibrate the volume', 'sample volume calibration') without method or gas. Degas printed: vacuum, 200 °C for 240 min. Pore data (Table 4/5): V_mic and S_mic by t-plot; V_total single point at P/P0 = 0.99 (N2); V_meso = V_total - V_mic; dp = 'average pore width of adsorption' (method not stated). BET relative-pressure range not stated.
